title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1013 | 转圈小行星、长角海参、6岁魔方纪录
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🪐 智利巨型望远镜发现两颗“疯狂转圈”的小行星，每五分钟自转一圈，快得像游乐场飞椅！
🌊 阿根廷深海发现 57 个新物种，一只长着小角的海参被昵称为“捣蛋鬼 Loki”！
🧩 6 岁中国女孩连允之三天两破女子魔方世界纪录，平均只需 4 秒多！

📖 Word of the day: trickster（捣蛋鬼）

🎮 小挑战：像小行星一样转圈，一分钟你能转几圈？用英语数出来，再教家人今天的单词 trickster！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🪐 Two giant asteroids spin all the way around every five minutes — like a fairground ride!
🌊 Scientists found fifty-seven new deep-sea animals off Argentina, including a horned sea cucumber nicknamed Loki!
🧩 Six-year-old Lian Yunzhi from China broke the women's Rubik's Cube world record twice — averaging just over four seconds!

📖 Word of the day: trickster

🎮 Tiny challenge: spin like an asteroid for one minute, count your spins out loud in English, and teach someone today's word "trickster"!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. trickster（捣蛋鬼）
a person who loves to play tricks and jokes
例：Loki the trickster（爱捣蛋的 Loki）

2. spin（旋转）
to turn around and around very fast
例：the asteroid spins every five minutes（小行星每五分钟转一圈）

3. horn（角）
a hard pointy part on some animals' heads
例：two little horns（两只小角）

4. record（纪录）
the best score anyone has ever done
例：a world record（世界纪录）
